description: v0.3.0 Ground-Truth Benchmark Suite for Verifier Engine & Advisory Feeds (ADR-019)

cases.name: Node.js jsonwebtoken missing algorithms
cases.expected_status_display: YES (本番コード内検出・要実地確認)
cases.description: Production code calls jwt.verify without algorithm restriction, test code specifies algorithms. Verifier must detect call in src/ and ignore tests/.

cases.name: Apache Tomcat AJP Connector Enabled (Ghostcat)
cases.description: server.xml defines active AJP/1.3 connector without secretRequired or secret set. Verifier must report YES (設定有効).

cases.name: PHP session.upload_progress LFI to RCE Vector Enabled
cases.description: php.ini enables session.upload_progress.enabled (LFI to RCE vector). Verifier must report YES (設定有効).

cases.name: Nginx HTTP/2 Protocol Enabled (HTTP2Shell / Rapid Reset)
cases.description: nginx.conf contains 'http2 on;' directive outside of comments. Verifier must report YES (設定有効).

negative_cases.name: Apache Tomcat AJP Connector Commented Out
negative_cases.expected_status_display: NO or 外部設定要確認 (非YES)
negative_cases.description: server.xml has AJP connector commented out. Verifier must NOT report YES.

negative_cases.name: PHP session.upload_progress LFI to RCE Vector Explicitly Disabled
negative_cases.description: php.ini sets session.upload_progress.enabled = Off. Verifier must NOT report YES.

negative_cases.name: Nginx HTTP/2 Explicitly Disabled with Commented Match
negative_cases.description: nginx.conf has 'http2 off;' and '# http2 on;'. Verifier must NOT report YES.

hard_cases.name: Case A: Nginx HTTP/2 in conf.d included file
hard_cases.description: nginx.conf has no http2 directive, but conf.d/site.conf enables listen 443 ssl http2. Verifier must traverse conf.d and report YES.

hard_cases.name: Case C2: Multiple server.xml with unprotected instance
hard_cases.description: Two server.xml files exist. One is protected, the second is unprotected (secretRequired=false). Verifier must report YES regardless of evaluation order.

hard_cases.name: Case G: PHP conf.d overrides base php.ini Off to On
hard_cases.description: php.ini sets session.upload_progress.enabled = Off, but conf.d/custom.ini re-enables it to On. Verifier must apply override order and report YES.

hard_cases.name: Case D: Tomcat HTTP/2 check not intercepted by AJP checker
hard_cases.expected_status_display: 外部設定要確認 (手動確認要)
hard_cases.description: Question asks about HTTP/2 on Tomcat. AJP connector is present in server.xml, but must NOT trigger AJP checker or falsely report YES.

hard_cases.name: Case E: Malformed XML server.xml safely handled
hard_cases.expected_status_display: 外部設定要確認 (構文エラー)
hard_cases.description: server.xml has XML parsing error. Verifier must NOT crash or silently ignore; must report safe fallback to 要確認.

feed_cases.name: Node.js upcoming pre-announcement feed
feed_cases.description: Node.js format 'will release on or shortly after Tuesday, November 10, 2026'. Must extract future date and severity.

feed_cases.name: Node.js past completed release article
feed_cases.description: Completed past release from July 2025. Must NOT be reported as upcoming pre-announcement.

feed_cases.name: Django RC release and EOL support end post
feed_cases.description: Release candidate article mentioning security support end date. Must NOT trigger future pre-announcement.

feed_cases.name: DjangoCon conference CFP post
feed_cases.description: Conference announcement mentioning security talks. Must NOT trigger future pre-announcement.

feed_cases.name: Tomcat RC release mentioning security updates
feed_cases.description: Tomcat RC post mentioning security updates end. Must NOT trigger future pre-announcement.

chain_cases.name: PHP2Shell + Fragnesia DMZ Critical Chain
chain_cases.description: Internet-facing workload with PHP2Shell RCE combined with unmitigated Fragnesia kernel LPE must trigger CRITICAL_CHAIN (48h).

chain_cases.name: Ubuntu AWS Kernel Flavor Distinction (No False Safe)
chain_cases.description: Ubuntu AWS 6.8.0-1015.16 must NOT be marked SAFE against generic 6.8.0-47.47 (1015 > 47); must evaluate to indeterminate and trigger CRITICAL_CHAIN.

chain_cases.name: CI Runner Untrusted Code Inherent Foothold
chain_cases.description: Workload executing untrusted code has inherent foothold; triggers CRITICAL_CHAIN on unmitigated kernel even with 0 app CVEs.

chain_cases.name: Web Fresh RCE Before Indexing (Safe-by-default Fallback)
chain_cases.expected_deadline: 2週間以内（足場リスク要人手確認）
chain_cases.description: Brand new RCE without CVSS/CWE/KEV must evaluate to HIGH_UNVERIFIED, never falsely declared non-foothold.

chain_cases.name: Fragnesia install /bin/false but module loaded in memory
chain_cases.description: Even if modprobe is configured, currently loaded modules (/proc/modules) mean kernel remains UNMITIGATED.

chain_cases.name: Fragnesia Fully Mitigated on DMZ
chain_cases.description: All 3 modules disabled via modprobe with no conflicting service allows 30-day routine patching window.

chain_cases.name: Fragnesia Blocked by IPsec Side-Effect Conflict
chain_cases.description: Active IPsec service makes disabling modules impossible; must evaluate as unmitigated and trigger CRITICAL_CHAIN.

chain_cases.name: Internal Workload Kernel LPE Lateral Movement Prevention
chain_cases.description: Dream incident lesson: internal workload on unmitigated kernel must be patched within 2 weeks to prevent lateral movement.

chain_cases.name: Ubuntu AWS Kernel 6.8.0-1015.16 Indeterminate Flavor Lookup
chain_cases.description: AWS kernel must NOT match generic Ubuntu fixed version; must fall back to indeterminate/vulnerable and trigger CRITICAL_CHAIN.

chain_cases.name: Missing Workload SBOM Failsafe to HIGH_UNVERIFIED
chain_cases.description: Non-existent SBOM on internet-facing workload must trigger HIGH_UNVERIFIED, never falsely treated as safe.

chain_cases.name: Workload SBOM + Triage Report Path PHP2Shell Critical Chain

check_points.content_summary: Uninitialized memory reference in session upload progress

chain_cases.description: Critical exploit chain detected via SBOM components and TriageReport check points (not entry_cves), normalized and enriched by KEV feed.

kernel_auto_cases.name: KEV-listed kernel CVE on a CI runner pool
kernel_auto_cases.description: An automatically found, unfixed KEV-listed LPE on a pool running untrusted code must be CRITICAL_CHAIN.

kernel_auto_cases.name: Tier 2 (EPSS only) is capped at HIGH_UNVERIFIED
kernel_auto_cases.description: A suspected LPE (EPSS above the threshold, not in KEV) is flagged but capped at HIGH_UNVERIFIED, not CRITICAL.

kernel_auto_cases.name: EPSS jump since the previous run promotes to tier 1
kernel_auto_cases.description: EPSS rising from 0.01 to 0.30 between daily runs promotes the CVE to tier 1 (CRITICAL_CHAIN on a foothold).

kernel_auto_cases.name: A first CVSS score is not a revision
kernel_auto_cases.description: A CVE scored 7.8 (LPE shape) for the first time is not promoted; most kernel CVEs get such a score.

kernel_auto_cases.name: CVSS revised upwards into the LPE shape promotes
kernel_auto_cases.description: A CVE re-scored from 5.5 (DoS) to 7.8 (local privilege escalation) is promoted to tier 1.

kernel_auto_cases.name: A fix for another kernel line is not applied
kernel_auto_cases.description: Amazon Linux 2 5.10.200 is still exposed even though the 4.14 line's fix (4.14.350) sorts lower than the installed version.

kernel_auto_cases.name: A CVE listed only for another kernel line does not leak in
kernel_auto_cases.description: On Amazon Linux 2023, a CVE fixed only in the kernel6.12 line (1:6.12.50) must not be reported for a pool running the 'kernel' 6.1 line, even though 6.1.100 sorts below 6.12.50.

kernel_auto_cases.name: Livepatch for the running build resolves the CVE
kernel_auto_cases.description: An installed livepatch built for exactly the running kernel, at or above the advisory's version, resolves the CVE.

kernel_auto_cases.name: Livepatch for another build does not count
kernel_auto_cases.description: A livepatch package built for a different kernel build does not resolve the CVE on this one.

kernel_auto_cases.name: A KEV-listed CVE without a fix stays exposed
kernel_auto_cases.description: When the distribution has not shipped a fix, the CVE is exposed (never SAFE) and still forms a chain.

kernel_auto_cases.name: A distribution without a source is not reported as clean
kernel_auto_cases.description: A pool whose distribution has no registered source is disclosed as 'no source', never as having no unfixed CVEs.

kernel_auto_cases.name: An unreachable source is not reported as clean
kernel_auto_cases.description: When the source cannot be reached, the pool is a lookup failure, never 'no unfixed CVEs'.

kernel_auto_cases.name: Partially collected pool is flagged even when nothing is exposed
kernel_auto_cases.description: With telemetry from 1 of 3 nodes, a clean-looking result must say other nodes may run older kernels.

kernel_auto_cases.name: A fully collected, fixed pool stays quiet
kernel_auto_cases.description: A pool whose every node runs a kernel at or above the fix reports nothing for that CVE and no coverage warning.
